Counsel for Petitioner :- Ashwini Kumar Singh,Avaneesh Kumar Singh Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Siddharth,J.
Hon'ble Avnish Saxena,J.
Heard Sri Ashwini Kumar Singh, counsel for the petitioner and learned A.G.A for the State.

The petition has been filed praying to stay the effect and operation of show cause notice dated 02.11.2019 under Section 3 of U.P. Control of Goondas Act, 1970 (State vs. Manish Pandey) as well as order dated 27.08.2020 of externment order passed by Additional District Magistrate (Land Revenue) Jaunpur in Case No. 01179 of 2019, Computer Case No. D201914360001179 (State vs.
Manish Pandey) under Section 3(1) of U.P. Control of Goondas Act.

sentences.text: A perusal of the impugned order shows that because of implication of petitioner in solitary case Crime No. 60 of 2018, under Section 376 IPC, P.S.- Chandawak, District- Jaunpur, he has been implicated in this case and externment order dated 27.08.2020 has been passed against him by the Additional District Magistrate (Land Revenue) Jaunpur.
It appears that the petitioner has not preferred any appeal against the externment order dated 27.08.2020.
The period of externment of six months mentioned in the order dated 27.08.2020 has already come to an end.
There is averment in the writ petition that the petitioner was never served with the notice of this case nor he was aware of the externment order.
In Case Crime No. 60 of 2018 trial was conducted and the petitioner has been acquitted by the judgment and order dated 04.03.2025 by the trial court.
He is not a habitual offender nor a goonda as defined under Section 2(b) of the U.P. Control of Goondas Act, 1970.
Learned A.G.A has opposed the submission and has submitted that the petition is barred by laches.

After hearing the rival contentions, this court finds that as per the judgment of this court passed in the case of Goverdhan vs. State of U.P., Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. 12619 of 2023, the implication under Goondas Act, only on the basis of single implication cannot be justified.

entities.text: Goverdhan vs. State of U.P., Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. 12619 of 2023
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the above, the impugned orders are quashed.
